categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of non-standard automated intelligent assembly equipment and testing equipment. Its main products include lithium-ion battery manufacturing equipment such as coating machines, injection equipment, helium leak detectors, and assembly devices, as well as intelligent manufacturing equipment for consumer electronics, construction robots, and medical robots. The business spans multiple industries including new energy, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, construction, and medical sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies in lithium-ion battery manufacturing, including advanced coating, injection, laser measurement, helium leak detection, and assembly techniques. It integrates mechanical engineering, optical engineering, control science, materials science, and electronics in its manufacturing processes. The company emphasizes modular design, digitalization, and automation, with strong R&D capabilities supported by nearly 300 engineers and multiple patented technologies. Production follows a make-to-order model based on customer-specific process requirements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading lithium battery manufacturers such as CATL, Sunwoda, CALB, EVE Energy, and Hive Energy, with long-term stable cooperation. The company also serves domestic ICT and home appliance leaders and is expanding overseas, having received orders from CATL's Hungary plant and engaging with dozens of international clients. The primary markets include lithium battery production for new energy vehicles, energy storage, and consumer electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production bases in Shenzhen and Zhongshan. It is actively expanding overseas markets, particularly in Europe (Hungary, Italy) and is preparing to establish an office in Italy to support international business growth. The company’s products are sold domestically and internationally, with increasing overseas sales contributing to growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lithium battery supply chain, focusing on manufacturing equipment for battery cell assembly and testing. It supplies critical production equipment to battery manufacturers, enabling automated and intelligent production processes. It also manages upstream procurement of standard and custom components and downstream delivery and on-site commissioning services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on deepening its leadership in lithium battery manufacturing equipment, especially coating and injection devices, while expanding into large cylindrical battery assembly and other sectors like semiconductor chip sorting, consumer electronics, medical and construction robotics. It prioritizes high-end, intelligent, and green manufacturing, invests heavily in R&D (5% of revenue), and pursues digital transformation through ERP, PLM, and AI technologies. Talent acquisition and supply chain optimization are also key priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized non-standard automated manufacturing equipment and related accessories. The company also earns from value-added services such as equipment upgrades and after-sales support. Sales are predominantly contract-based with pricing determined via bidding for equipment and negotiation for parts and services. The company operates a make-to-order production model aligned with customer contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in lithium battery coating equipment with a 39% market share, ranking first domestically. It competes with firms like Desun Intelligent, Omega, Kerei Technology, Xinghe, Zecheng Automation, and Jiatuo Intelligent. While rapidly growing, it faces competition from established players in scale, product range, and capital strength. The company leverages its technological innovation and customer relationships to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.12 billion, a 56.7% increase year-over-year, driven by increased equipment acceptance. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 56.1 million, down 25.8% due to margin pressure, increased R&D and management expenses, and higher impairment losses. Total assets reached RMB 2.05 billion, up 14.3%. The company completed a successful IPO in July 2023, issuing 10 million shares and raising RMB 839 million, significantly enhancing its capital base.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced, and highly automated intelligent manufacturing equipment tailored to customer-specific processes. Its products integrate multiple functions such as precision coating, injection, laser measurement, and leak detection, supported by proprietary patents and digital MES system integration. The company’s modular design and lifecycle management approach ensure stable performance, cost efficiency, and adaptability to evolving battery technologies, providing customers with reliable and efficient production solutions.
